desc:
🦀 Scary Fishing

You and your crew have been hired to run a crab fishing ship in the middle of a cold, unforgiving ocean. At first, the job seems simple: catch crabs, sort them, and survive another day at sea.

But these aren't ordinary crabs.

As you venture farther from shore, strange creatures begin crawling up from the depths. Some are larger than your ship. Some move where they shouldn't. And some are always watching from beneath the waves.

Work together with your friends to operate the ship, haul in traps, complete fishing contracts, and uncover the secrets hidden in the ocean. Upgrade your equipment, prepare for unexpected encounters, and do whatever it takes to make it back to port alive.

Catch crabs.  Survive the horrors below.

⚓ Cooperative multiplayer
🦀 Catch rare and valuable crabs
🚢 Upgrade and customize your fishing vessel
🌊 Explore dangerous waters
👁 Encounter terrifying creatures from the deep
💀 Try to survive the night

The ocean is hungry.
